name: Maxim
description: Behavioral intelligence layer for Claude Code. Every output cites a peer-reviewed framework (64 total: Fogg, COM-B, Cialdini, Hook Model, and more), clears 14 compliance checks (GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, ISO 13485…), and carries a confidence rubric. 88 specialist agents dispatch through 7 executive offices. BSL 1.1 (converts to Apache 2.0 in 2030).
longDescription:
Ships **52 skills**, **1 agent**, **50 commands**, **4 hooks** and **9 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (52): `ai-media-generation`, `banner-design` (Maxim Banner Design Intelligence — digital banner creation, ad creative, social media banners, hero sections, display advertising, promotional…), `behavior-science-persuasion`, `brand` (Maxim Brand Intelligence — brand identity, voice architecture, visual identity systems, messaging frameworks, brand consistency enforcement), `ceo-automation`, `company-teardown`, `competitor-watch`, `compliance`, and 44 more
- **Agents** (1): `MXM`
- **Commands** (50): `mxm-arch` (TIER 3 persona — enterprise architects (TOGAF / C4 / ArchiMate / Wardley practitioners)), `mxm-behavior` (Apply a behavioral framework from FRAMEWORKS_MASTER to any task), `mxm-brand-voice` (Three-layer brand foundation voice system), `mxm-build` (TIER 1 verb-first — build a feature, module, or capability), `mxm-ceo-morning` (CEO morning cycle — overnight-delta summary, priority queue, finance + partnerships scan, blockers surfaced, next-24h plan generated from…), `mxm-ceo-overnight` (CEO overnight cycle — scheduled automation that runs while the operator sleeps, processes portfolio signals, and prepares the…), `mxm-ceo-setup` (One-time CEO automation setup — wires .mxm-executive-summary/ context, portfolio scheduled tasks, and CEO-office agent roster), `mxm-ceo` (Routes to the CEO Office), and 42 more
- **Hooks** (4): `SessionStart`, `SessionEnd`, `PreToolUse`, `UserPromptSubmit`
- **MCP servers** (9): `mxm-portfolio`, `mxm-context`, `mxm-catalog`, `mxm-compliance`, `mxm-behavioral`, `mxm-memory`, `mxm-voice`, `mxm-commands`, and 1 more

Installs with `claude plugin install maxim@claude-community` from `DrNabeelKhan/maxim`.
